---
title: "Examples"
---

Interactive examples demonstrating each DeckGL.jl layer type. Each visualization below is rendered using deck.gl.

## ScatterplotLayer

Renders circles at geographic coordinates. Size and color can be data-driven.

```julia
data = (
    lng = [-122.4, -122.45, -122.35, -122.42, -122.38],
    lat = [37.8, 37.75, 37.85, 37.78, 37.82],
    size = [100, 150, 80, 120, 90]
)

layer = ScatterplotLayer(
    data = data,
    get_position = [:lng, :lat],
    get_radius = :size,
    get_fill_color = [255, 140, 0, 200],
    radius_min_pixels = 5
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="scatterplot-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/deck.gl@9.0.16/dist.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {position: [-122.4, 37.8], size: 100},
        {position: [-122.45, 37.75], size: 150},
        {position: [-122.35, 37.85], size: 80},
        {position: [-122.42, 37.78], size: 120},
        {position: [-122.38, 37.82], size: 90},
        {position: [-122.41, 37.79], size: 110},
        {position: [-122.43, 37.81], size: 95},
        {position: [-122.39, 37.77], size: 130},
        {position: [-122.44, 37.83], size: 85},
        {position: [-122.36, 37.76], size: 140}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'scatterplot-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 12,
            pitch: 0
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.ScatterplotLayer({
                id: 'scatterplot',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getRadius: d => d.size,
                getFillColor: [255, 140, 0, 200],
                radiusMinPixels: 5,
                radiusMaxPixels: 50
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## ArcLayer

Renders arcs between source and target coordinates. Great for showing connections or flows.

```julia
trips = (
    src_lng = [-122.4, -122.4, -122.4],
    src_lat = [37.8, 37.8, 37.8],
    dst_lng = [-73.9, -87.6, -118.2],
    dst_lat = [40.7, 41.9, 34.0]
)

layer = ArcLayer(
    data = trips,
    get_source_position = [:src_lng, :src_lat],
    get_target_position = [:dst_lng, :dst_lat],
    get_source_color = [0, 128, 255],
    get_target_color = [255, 0, 128],
    get_width = 3
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="arc-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {source: [-122.4, 37.8], target: [-73.9, 40.7]},
        {source: [-122.4, 37.8], target: [-87.6, 41.9]},
        {source: [-122.4, 37.8], target: [-118.2, 34.0]},
        {source: [-73.9, 40.7], target: [-87.6, 41.9]},
        {source: [-87.6, 41.9], target: [-118.2, 34.0]}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'arc-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -98,
            latitude: 39,
            zoom: 3,
            pitch: 30
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.ArcLayer({
                id: 'arcs',
                data: data,
                getSourcePosition: d => d.source,
                getTargetPosition: d => d.target,
                getSourceColor: [0, 128, 255],
                getTargetColor: [255, 0, 128],
                getWidth: 3
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## LineLayer

Renders straight lines between points. Simpler than arcs, useful for direct connections.

```julia
connections = (
    from_lng = [-122.4, -122.45, -122.35],
    from_lat = [37.8, 37.75, 37.85],
    to_lng = [-122.45, -122.35, -122.4],
    to_lat = [37.75, 37.85, 37.8]
)

layer = LineLayer(
    data = connections,
    get_source_position = [:from_lng, :from_lat],
    get_target_position = [:to_lng, :to_lat],
    get_color = [64, 192, 128, 200],
    get_width = 3
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="line-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {source: [-122.4, 37.8], target: [-122.45, 37.75]},
        {source: [-122.45, 37.75], target: [-122.35, 37.85]},
        {source: [-122.35, 37.85], target: [-122.4, 37.8]},
        {source: [-122.42, 37.78], target: [-122.38, 37.82]},
        {source: [-122.38, 37.82], target: [-122.43, 37.77]}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'line-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 12
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.LineLayer({
                id: 'lines',
                data: data,
                getSourcePosition: d => d.source,
                getTargetPosition: d => d.target,
                getColor: [64, 192, 128, 200],
                getWidth: 3
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## PathLayer

Renders polylines/paths from sequences of coordinates. Ideal for routes, tracks, or boundaries.

```julia
routes = (
    path = [
        [[-122.4, 37.8], [-122.42, 37.78], [-122.45, 37.75]],
        [[-122.35, 37.85], [-122.38, 37.82], [-122.4, 37.8]]
    ],
    name = ["Route A", "Route B"]
)

layer = PathLayer(
    data = routes,
    get_path = :path,
    get_color = [0, 128, 255, 200],
    get_width = 5,
    cap_rounded = true
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="path-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {path: [[-122.4, 37.8], [-122.42, 37.78], [-122.44, 37.76], [-122.45, 37.75]], color: [0, 128, 255]},
        {path: [[-122.35, 37.85], [-122.37, 37.83], [-122.39, 37.81], [-122.4, 37.8]], color: [255, 128, 0]},
        {path: [[-122.43, 37.82], [-122.41, 37.79], [-122.38, 37.77], [-122.36, 37.76]], color: [128, 0, 255]}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'path-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 12
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.PathLayer({
                id: 'paths',
                data: data,
                getPath: d => d.path,
                getColor: d => d.color,
                getWidth: 5,
                capRounded: true,
                jointRounded: true
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## PolygonLayer

Renders filled polygons. Supports 3D extrusion for building-like visualizations.

```julia
regions = (
    polygon = [
        [[[-122.42, 37.78], [-122.45, 37.75], [-122.43, 37.73], [-122.40, 37.75], [-122.42, 37.78]]],
        [[[-122.38, 37.82], [-122.40, 37.80], [-122.36, 37.79], [-122.35, 37.81], [-122.38, 37.82]]]
    ],
    height = [100, 150]
)

layer = PolygonLayer(
    data = regions,
    get_polygon = :polygon,
    get_fill_color = [255, 140, 0, 150],
    get_line_color = [255, 140, 0, 255],
    extruded = true,
    get_elevation = :height
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="polygon-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {
            polygon: [[-122.42, 37.78], [-122.44, 37.76], [-122.42, 37.74], [-122.40, 37.76]],
            height: 200,
            color: [255, 140, 0, 180]
        },
        {
            polygon: [[-122.38, 37.82], [-122.40, 37.80], [-122.37, 37.79], [-122.35, 37.81]],
            height: 300,
            color: [0, 140, 255, 180]
        },
        {
            polygon: [[-122.45, 37.80], [-122.47, 37.78], [-122.45, 37.76], [-122.43, 37.78]],
            height: 150,
            color: [140, 255, 0, 180]
        }
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'polygon-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.78,
            zoom: 12,
            pitch: 45,
            bearing: 15
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.PolygonLayer({
                id: 'polygons',
                data: data,
                getPolygon: d => d.polygon,
                getFillColor: d => d.color,
                getLineColor: [80, 80, 80],
                getElevation: d => d.height,
                extruded: true,
                elevationScale: 10,
                lineWidthMinPixels: 1
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## TextLayer

Renders text labels at geographic coordinates.

```julia
cities = (
    lng = [-122.4, -122.45, -122.35],
    lat = [37.8, 37.75, 37.85],
    name = ["Downtown", "South Bay", "North Bay"]
)

layer = TextLayer(
    data = cities,
    get_position = [:lng, :lat],
    get_text = :name,
    get_size = 20,
    get_color = [0, 0, 0]
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="text-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const data = [
        {position: [-122.4, 37.8], text: 'Downtown SF', size: 20},
        {position: [-122.45, 37.75], text: 'Daly City', size: 16},
        {position: [-122.35, 37.85], text: 'Berkeley', size: 16},
        {position: [-122.42, 37.77], text: 'Mission', size: 14},
        {position: [-122.38, 37.82], text: 'Marina', size: 14}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'text-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 11
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.ScatterplotLayer({
                id: 'points',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getRadius: 100,
                getFillColor: [255, 0, 0, 200],
                radiusMinPixels: 5
            }),
            new deck.TextLayer({
                id: 'text',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getText: d => d.text,
                getSize: d => d.size,
                getColor: [0, 0, 0, 255],
                getPixelOffset: [0, -20],
                fontFamily: 'Arial, sans-serif',
                fontWeight: 'bold'
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## HexagonLayer

Aggregates points into hexagonal bins. Height represents density or aggregated values.

```julia
# Generate random point data
n = 5000
points = (
    lng = -122.4 .+ 0.1 .* randn(n),
    lat = 37.8 .+ 0.1 .* randn(n),
    value = rand(n)
)

layer = HexagonLayer(
    data = points,
    get_position = [:lng, :lat],
    radius = 200,
    elevation_scale = 50,
    extruded = true
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="hexagon-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    // Generate random clustered data
    const data = [];
    const clusters = [
        [-122.4, 37.8, 500],
        [-122.45, 37.75, 300],
        [-122.35, 37.82, 400]
    ];

    clusters.forEach(([cx, cy, count]) => {
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            data.push({
                position: [
                    cx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05,
                    cy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05
                ]
            });
        }
    });

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'hexagon-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 11,
            pitch: 45,
            bearing: 15
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.HexagonLayer({
                id: 'hexagons',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                radius: 200,
                elevationScale: 50,
                elevationRange: [0, 500],
                extruded: true,
                coverage: 0.9,
                colorRange: [
                    [255, 255, 178],
                    [254, 217, 118],
                    [254, 178, 76],
                    [253, 141, 60],
                    [240, 59, 32],
                    [189, 0, 38]
                ]
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## GridLayer

Similar to HexagonLayer but uses rectangular grid cells.

```julia
points = (
    lng = -122.4 .+ 0.1 .* randn(n),
    lat = 37.8 .+ 0.1 .* randn(n)
)

layer = GridLayer(
    data = points,
    get_position = [:lng, :lat],
    cell_size = 200,
    elevation_scale = 50,
    extruded = true
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="grid-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    // Generate random clustered data
    const data = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
        const cluster = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
        const centers = [[-122.4, 37.8], [-122.45, 37.76], [-122.35, 37.83]];
        data.push({
            position: [
                centers[cluster][0] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04,
                centers[cluster][1] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04
            ]
        });
    }

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'grid-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.8,
            zoom: 11,
            pitch: 45,
            bearing: -15
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.GridLayer({
                id: 'grid',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                cellSize: 200,
                elevationScale: 50,
                elevationRange: [0, 300],
                extruded: true,
                coverage: 0.9,
                colorRange: [
                    [255, 255, 204],
                    [199, 233, 180],
                    [127, 205, 187],
                    [65, 182, 196],
                    [44, 127, 184],
                    [37, 52, 148]
                ]
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## HeatmapLayer

Renders a smooth density heatmap. Great for visualizing point density.

```julia
incidents = (
    lng = -122.4 .+ 0.1 .* randn(10000),
    lat = 37.8 .+ 0.1 .* randn(10000)
)

layer = HeatmapLayer(
    data = incidents,
    get_position = [:lng, :lat],
    radius_pixels = 30,
    intensity = 1,
    threshold = 0.03
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="heatmap-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    // Generate random clustered data for heatmap
    const data = [];
    const clusters = [
        [-122.41, 37.79, 2000],
        [-122.43, 37.77, 1500],
        [-122.38, 37.81, 1200],
        [-122.45, 37.75, 800]
    ];

    clusters.forEach(([cx, cy, count]) => {
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            data.push({
                position: [
                    cx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.03,
                    cy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.03
                ],
                weight: Math.random()
            });
        }
    });

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'heatmap-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.41,
            latitude: 37.78,
            zoom: 12
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.HeatmapLayer({
                id: 'heatmap',
                data: data,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getWeight: d => d.weight,
                radiusPixels: 40,
                intensity: 1,
                threshold: 0.03,
                colorRange: [
                    [0, 0, 255, 0],
                    [0, 0, 255, 255],
                    [0, 255, 0, 255],
                    [255, 255, 0, 255],
                    [255, 0, 0, 255]
                ]
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## GeoJsonLayer

Renders GeoJSON data including points, lines, and polygons.

```julia
geojson_data = Dict(
    "type" => "FeatureCollection",
    "features" => [
        Dict(
            "type" => "Feature",
            "geometry" => Dict(
                "type" => "Polygon",
                "coordinates" => [[[-122.4, 37.8], ...]]
            ),
            "properties" => Dict("name" => "Region A")
        )
    ]
)

layer = GeoJsonLayer(
    data = geojson_data,
    get_fill_color = [255, 0, 0, 100],
    get_line_color = [255, 0, 0, 255]
)
```

```{=html}
<div id="geojson-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const geojsonData = {
        type: 'FeatureCollection',
        features: [
            {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                    type: 'Polygon',
                    coordinates: [[
                        [-122.45, 37.78],
                        [-122.43, 37.75],
                        [-122.40, 37.76],
                        [-122.41, 37.79],
                        [-122.45, 37.78]
                    ]]
                },
                properties: { name: 'Region A', value: 100 }
            },
            {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                    type: 'Polygon',
                    coordinates: [[
                        [-122.40, 37.82],
                        [-122.38, 37.80],
                        [-122.35, 37.81],
                        [-122.36, 37.84],
                        [-122.40, 37.82]
                    ]]
                },
                properties: { name: 'Region B', value: 150 }
            },
            {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                    type: 'LineString',
                    coordinates: [
                        [-122.45, 37.78],
                        [-122.42, 37.80],
                        [-122.40, 37.82]
                    ]
                },
                properties: { name: 'Route 1' }
            },
            {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                    type: 'Point',
                    coordinates: [-122.42, 37.78]
                },
                properties: { name: 'Point A' }
            },
            {
                type: 'Feature',
                geometry: {
                    type: 'Point',
                    coordinates: [-122.37, 37.82]
                },
                properties: { name: 'Point B' }
            }
        ]
    };

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'geojson-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.4,
            latitude: 37.79,
            zoom: 12
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.GeoJsonLayer({
                id: 'geojson',
                data: geojsonData,
                filled: true,
                stroked: true,
                getFillColor: f => {
                    if (f.geometry.type === 'Polygon') {
                        return [255, 140, 0, 150];
                    }
                    return [255, 0, 0, 200];
                },
                getLineColor: [0, 0, 0, 200],
                getLineWidth: 2,
                getPointRadius: 200,
                lineWidthMinPixels: 2,
                pointRadiusMinPixels: 5
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```

## Multiple Layers

Combine multiple layer types in a single visualization.

```julia
deck = Deck([
    ScatterplotLayer(data=points, ...),
    TextLayer(data=labels, ...),
    PathLayer(data=routes, ...)
])
```

```{=html}
<div id="multi-container" style="width: 100%; height: 400px; position: relative;"></div>
<script>
(function() {
    const cities = [
        {position: [-122.4, 37.8], name: 'San Francisco', size: 300},
        {position: [-122.27, 37.87], name: 'Berkeley', size: 200},
        {position: [-122.22, 37.77], name: 'Oakland', size: 250}
    ];

    const routes = [
        {path: [[-122.4, 37.8], [-122.35, 37.82], [-122.27, 37.87]]},
        {path: [[-122.4, 37.8], [-122.32, 37.78], [-122.22, 37.77]]},
        {path: [[-122.27, 37.87], [-122.25, 37.82], [-122.22, 37.77]]}
    ];

    new deck.DeckGL({
        container: 'multi-container',
        initialViewState: {
            longitude: -122.32,
            latitude: 37.82,
            zoom: 11
        },
        controller: true,
        layers: [
            new deck.PathLayer({
                id: 'routes',
                data: routes,
                getPath: d => d.path,
                getColor: [100, 100, 100, 150],
                getWidth: 3,
                capRounded: true
            }),
            new deck.ScatterplotLayer({
                id: 'cities',
                data: cities,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getRadius: d => d.size,
                getFillColor: [0, 128, 255, 200],
                radiusMinPixels: 10
            }),
            new deck.TextLayer({
                id: 'labels',
                data: cities,
                getPosition: d => d.position,
                getText: d => d.name,
                getSize: 16,
                getColor: [0, 0, 0],
                getPixelOffset: [0, -30],
                fontWeight: 'bold'
            })
        ]
    });
})();
</script>
```
